scene2_lost_drone.seed_rule: development seeds 0 to 199, four drones, primary camera, perfect radio, one drone (drawn per seed) lost at half a sweep's time, frozen Phase 16 settings; candidates: seeds where the person is in the lost drone's lawnmower strip, on ground no lawnmower drone had covered when it was lost (the situation the lost-drone result is about; decided from the person's position and the lost drone only, both drawn before any detection, and from the lawnmower's fixed routes); chosen: the candidate whose lawnmower-minus-sweep time to a confirmed find (the horizon when none) is closest to the median of that difference over the candidates; ties to the lower seed (D-767).
